soru: Makine öğrenmesi hatlarında farklı saldırganların birlikte hareket ederek güvenlik, gizlilik ve adalet risklerini güçlendirmesi üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Makine öğrenmesi hatlarında farklı saldırganların birlikte hareket ederek güvenlik, gizlilik ve adalet risklerini güçlendirmesi üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-05-08. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first), each with its arXiv id and/or DOI. You may search the web.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: SoK: Colluding Adversaries in Machine Learning Pipelines
calismalar.gerekce: This is the main systematization of collusion. It gives a framework for train-time and inference-time adversaries coordinating with each other, and for inference-time adversaries coordinating among themselves, plus guidelines for predicting collusion.

calismalar.baslik: Truth Serum: Poisoning Machine Learning Models to Reveal Their Secrets
calismalar.gerekce: It is the canonical demonstration that a poisoning adversary can greatly amplify membership and attribute inference attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Amplifying Membership Exposure via Data Poisoning
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that targeted clean-label poisoning raises the membership exposure of specific data points.

calismalar.baslik: SoK: Unintended Interactions among Machine Learning Defenses and Risks
calismalar.gerekce: It systematizes how defenses for one risk amplify or reduce other security, privacy and fairness risks.

calismalar.baslik: Property Inference from Poisoning
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that poisoning amplifies inference of a dataset's global properties.

calismalar.baslik: SNAP: Efficient Extraction of Private Properties with Poisoning
calismalar.gerekce: It makes property inference much more efficient by combining it with poisoning.

calismalar.baslik: Privacy Backdoors: Enhancing Membership Inference through Poisoning Pre-trained Models
calismalar.gerekce: It shows collusion between pre-trained model suppliers and inference attackers across the supply chain.

calismalar.baslik: Privacy Backdoors: Stealing Data with Corrupted Pretrained Models
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that a tampered pre-trained model can leak fine-tuning data.

calismalar.baslik: Conflicting Interactions Among Protection Mechanisms for Machine Learning Models
calismalar.gerekce: It empirically shows that protection mechanisms against different adversaries conflict with each other.

calismalar.baslik: Privacy Risks of Securing Machine Learning Models against Adversarial Examples
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that adversarial robustness defenses increase membership inference risk.

calismalar.baslik: On the Privacy Risks of Algorithmic Fairness
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that fairness constraints raise privacy risk for underrepresented groups.

calismalar.baslik: Exacerbating Algorithmic Bias through Fairness Attacks
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that poisoning attacks can deliberately worsen fairness.

calismalar.baslik: Poisoning Attacks on Algorithmic Fairness
calismalar.gerekce: It is foundational work on how a train-time adversary can degrade fairness.

calismalar.baslik: Practical Black-Box Attacks against Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: It is the classic example of a model extraction (substitute model) adversary enabling an evasion adversary.

calismalar.baslik: Stealing Machine Learning Models via Prediction APIs
calismalar.gerekce: It is the foundational model extraction attack, which acts as a stepping stone for later attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Knockoff Nets: Stealing Functionality of Black-Box Models
calismalar.gerekce: It shows functionality-stealing extraction that can feed other attacks.

calismalar.baslik: PRADA: Protecting Against DNN Model Stealing Attacks
calismalar.gerekce: It addresses detection of extraction attacks and connects them to transferable adversarial examples.

calismalar.baslik: Towards Reverse-Engineering Black-Box Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that inferring model attributes strengthens subsequent evasion attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Stealing Part of a Production Language Model
calismalar.gerekce: It shows extraction against production LLMs, which can enable further attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Membership Inference Attacks against Machine Learning Models
calismalar.gerekce: It is the foundational membership inference work and the target of many amplification attacks.

calismalar.baslik: Membership Inference Attacks From First Principles
calismalar.gerekce: It introduced LiRA, the strong attack used to measure membership inference amplified by collusion.

calismalar.baslik: Label-Only Membership Inference Attacks
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that adversarial-example (evasion) techniques power membership inference.

calismalar.baslik: The Privacy Onion Effect: Memorization is Relative
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that removing data or applying defenses exposes other points to privacy risk.

calismalar.baslik: Machine Learning Models that Remember Too Much
calismalar.gerekce: It shows a malicious training procedure covertly encoding data into the model.

calismalar.baslik: Formalizing and Estimating Distribution Inference Risks
calismalar.gerekce: It formalizes distribution and property inference, one of the risks that collusion amplifies.

calismalar.baslik: Dissecting Distribution Inference
calismalar.gerekce: It analyzes the factors that affect distribution inference, which helps explain enabling factors for collusion.

calismalar.baslik: Are Attribute Inference Attacks Just Imputation?
calismalar.gerekce: It re-evaluates attribute inference risk and is the basis for measuring attacks amplified by poisoning.

calismalar.baslik: Adversarial Examples Make Strong Poisons
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that inference-time adversarial example techniques combine with train-time poisoning.

calismalar.baslik: When Machine Unlearning Jeopardizes Privacy
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that a defense or mechanism introduced at one pipeline stage creates new privacy leakage.

calismalar.baslik: Fairwashing: the risk of rationalization
calismalar.gerekce: It shows that explanation mechanisms can be manipulated to hide fairness risks, an example of interaction between fairness and transparency risks.
